components.css: .ds-binder { font-family: "Be Vietnam Pro", sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #16181D); } .ds-tablist { display: flex; gap: 6px; position: relative; z-index: 10; margin-bottom: -1.5px; } .ds-tab { border: 1.5px solid var(--color-ink, #16181D); border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; background: var(--color-paper-tab, #EAE5DA); color: var(--color-ink-muted, #4A4E57); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-tab:hover { background: var(--color-paper-soft, #FAF8F3); color: var(--color-ink, #16181D); } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--color-sheet, #FFFFFF); color: var(--color-ink, #16181D); border-bottom-color: var(--color-sheet, #FFFFFF); } .ds-tab-code { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #4A4E57); margin-right: 4px; } .ds-sheet { position: relative; z-index: 1; background: var(--color-sheet, #FFFFFF); border: 1.5px solid var(--color-ink, #16181D); border-radius: 0 10px 10px 10px; padding: 18px 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -18px rgba(22, 24, 29, 0.22); } .ds-sheet-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #4A4E57); padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #D6D1C4); } .ds-sheet-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding-top: 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-pill-free { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; background: var(--color-blueprint-soft, #E6EEFC); color: var(--color-blueprint, #23469E); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
CourseShop treats programming education as a tactile engineering handbook rather than a flash-sale marketplace or dark neon SaaS pitch. Warm limestone paper grounds frame crisp white binder sheets separated by physical top-attached career-path tabs, carbon-ink structural rules, and disciplined two-color coding that immediately distinguishes 0đ foundation labs from paid production projects.

Every visual token earns its place through utility: typography preserves crisp Vietnamese diacritics across headings and dense syllabus tables, monospaced tabular numerals keep VND prices, course codes (`LAB-01`, `PRO-02`), and video timestamps aligned vertically, and dark surfaces appear only where video playback demands zero glare inside `/learn`.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile limestone paper ground (`#F4F1EA`) paired with crisp white ink-ruled index sheets (`#FFFFFF`) and structural 1.5px carbon-ink borders (`#16181D`).

Strict dual-accent semantic coding: Blueprint Indigo exclusively for Free foundation tracks and primary learning flows; Safety Amber exclusively for Pro projects, discounts, and paid conversion actions.
Physical top-attached Lab Binder tabs that fuse seamlessly into the active white syllabus sheet without dividing lines.
Vietnamese-crisp neo-grotesk sans (`Be Vietnam Pro`) paired with tabular monospaced engineering codes (`JetBrains Mono`), both self-hosted as local `.woff2` assets.
Zero decorative kickers, zero neon gradients, zero emoji chrome (100% Lucide stroke icons), and a dedicated dark-theatre learning surface (`/learn`).

rules.name: The Dual-Ink Ownership Rule
rules.body: Blueprint Indigo (`#23469E`) owns Free foundations and learning progress; Amber (`#B45309` / `#D97706`) owns Pro projects and commercial discounts. Never swap them or introduce competing brand hues.

rules.name: The AA Amber Text Rule
rules.body: White text on amber surfaces uses `#B45309` (not `#D97706`), while light `#FEF3C7` badges always pair with `#78350F` text to stay safely above WCAG AA 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Zero-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headlines open directly with the thesis; never place uppercase tracked eyebrows or pill kickers above `h1` or section headings.

rules.name: The Tabular Currency Rule
rules.body: Every VND price, lesson duration, timestamp, order number, and KPI counter applies `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so numbers align cleanly across grids and admin ledgers.

rules.name: The Structural Ink Rule
rules.body: Never use hard offset neobrutalist shadows (`4px 4px 0 #000`); crispness comes from `1.5px solid #16181D` borders paired with restrained diffused lift on state changes.

dos: Do fuse active binder tabs seamlessly into `.binder-sheet` using `.binder-tablist` negative overlap (`-1.5px`) and matching `#FFFFFF` bottom border.
Do present both Free (`LAB-*`, Blueprint Indigo) and Pro (`PRO-*`, Safety Amber) courses visibly in the storefront's first viewport so learners see the 0đ-to-Pro progression immediately.
Do self-host `Be Vietnam Pro` and `JetBrains Mono` `.woff2` subsets with `tabular-nums` on every VND price, lesson duration, timestamp, and order code.
Do wrap Vietnamese titles naturally inside syllabus cards and mobile views instead of mid-word `truncate` clipping.
Do keep `select.lab-select` free of native OS triangles by pairing `appearance: none` with Lucide `chevron-down` icons and `pr-8` clearance.
Do keep toasts anchored at `bottom-left` so they never cover top-right header CTAs or the bottom-right AI chat trigger.
donts: Don't add Bootstrap, generic glassmorphism, neon glow gradients, or hard offset neobrutalist shadows anywhere in the system.
Don't place uppercase tracked kickers or pill eyebrows above `h1` or section headings.
Don't use Unicode emojis as UI icons; always use Lucide stroke icons consistently.
Don't place white text on `#D97706` or drop secondary text contrast below WCAG AA `4.5:1` (never add `opacity-75` to `#4A4E57` labels on `#EAE5DA`).
Don't duplicate filter controls (such as placing category pills immediately beneath a category `<select>` dropdown).
Don't fabricate real-world commercial numbers, student testimonials, or partner logos; keep demo data honestly structured and disclosed.
